ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Near-zero macro-level ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels; surface is characterized by a nearly uniform low-intensity (dark) distribution across the visible fluke face.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: No distinct high-contrast contiguous geometric blobs or mottling present; the surface exhibits a continuous, solid low-intensity pixel mapping.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression at the central lobe convergence with sharp angular transition.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the trailing edge, characterized by a significant macroscopic semi-circular indentation on the left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve transitioning to elongated, tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes, forming dense, roughly circular localized groupings.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant traumatic indentation (missing tissue) on the trailing edge of the left lobe; dense white clusters (barnacles) localized at the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme lateral tips exhibit heavy high-intensity pixel colonization which contrasts sharply with the low-intensity uniform surface of the main fluke body.
